words.sentence: We saw dinosaur bones at the museum.
words.def: You can see old and interesting things here.

words.sentence: We took a taxi to the airport.
words.def: You go here to get on a plane.

words.sentence: A king lived in this castle.
words.def: Kings and queens lived in this big old building.

words.sentence: They make cars in this factory.

words.sentence: We had pizza at the restaurant.
words.def: You can go here to eat a meal. You do not cook it!
